forbidden: broad partial load that silently drops shape mismatches

model.lora_target: attention and feed-forward adapters in both Gemma blocks
model.freeze_rule: whole backbone frozen (PaliGemma LLM + SigLIP vision encoder, bfloat16); trainable target is exactly the 20 LoRA tensors plus action_in_proj, action_out_proj, time_mlp_in and time_mlp_out
model.freeze_note: this is deliberately stricter than OpenPI's gemma_2b_lora convenience filter, which leaves the 400M SigLIP encoder trainable

data.image_processing: OpenPI ResizeImages 224x224 with pad; uint8 HWC input
data.action_chunk: 10 consecutive control frames inside one episode; tails that would cross an episode boundary are excluded

checkpoint.step_note: Orbax directory names are loop indices; TrainState.step is authoritative and is recorded separately
resume_limits: RNG and data-loader cursor are not saved by this OpenPI version
restore verifies params, optimizer state and TrainState.step only; it is not sample-exact replay

memory_plans.description: LoRA adapters, frozen bf16 backbone, batch 1, one RTX 4090

instrumentation.parameter_delta: compare common tensors against pi05_libero and trainable tensors between step checkpoints
